# Nurse.com

> > Nurse.com is the leading online resource for nurses, offering ANCC-accredited continuing education, career development tools, nursing jobs, and a vibrant professional community.

Nurse.com serves nursing professionals across the U.S. and Canada with comprehensive resources including CE courses, career advice, NCLEX preparation, and industry news. The platform features expert contributors like Alice Benjamin, Cat Golden, and Jennifer Adamy, and partners with organizations like the American Nurses Association (ANA) to support nurses at every career stage.

## Key Topics

- Continuing Education (CE)
- National Nurses Week
- NCLEX Preparation
- Career Development
- Patient Safety
- Professional Development
- Workplace Violence Prevention
- Travel Nursing
- Nurse Appreciation
- Pediatric Emergency Care
- American Nurses Association (ANA)
- Career Transitions
- Nursing Webinars
- Home Health Nursing
- Nurse Wellness

## Core Resources

- [Nursing Jobs, CE Courses, & News | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com): Homepage for nursing jobs, ANCC-accredited CE courses, and nurse community
- [Your Source for Nurse News & Blogs | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/blog): Nursing blog with career advice, news, CE credit, and NCLEX resources
- [Nurse Conferences & Events | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events): Main events hub for nursing conferences, webinars, and CE opportunities

## Professional Development & Career Events

- [National Nurses Week 2025: Day of Inspiration | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/national-nurses-week-2025-virtual): Virtual National Nurses Week 2025 celebration and career development event
- [Aspire Convention](https://www.nurse.com/events/anpd): ANPD Aspire Convention 2026 in Louisville for NPD professionals
- [Nurses Night In - Career Transitions | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/nurses-night-in-career-transitions-oct24): Virtual event for new grads on career transitions with Katie Duke
- [Nurses Night In - Travel Nursing | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/nurses-night-in-travel-nursing-mar25): Virtual event on travel nursing careers and contract negotiation
- [Nurse Cruise Kickoff: Nurses Night In | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/nurses-night-in-bucket-list-jan25): Career planning event with Cat Golden and cruise giveaway opportunity

## Clinical Education & Patient Safety

- [Preventing Violence in Healthcare: What You Need to Know | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/preventing-violence-in-healthcare-part-1): Workplace violence scope and prevention strategies webinar series
- [Preventing Violence in Healthcare: What Actually Works | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/preventing-violence-in-healthcare-part-2): Evidence-based workplace violence prevention training for nurses
- [Pediatric Emergency Care Essentials Webinar | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/kids-arent-just-small-adults-pediatric-emergency-fundamentals): CE webinar on pediatric emergency care and rapid assessment tools
- [Rapid Response Team Webinar for Nurses | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/rapid-response-ready): Webinar on rapid response team preparation and patient deterioration
- [For Nurses, By Nurses: Leading Innovation at the Bedside and Beyond | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/for-nurses-by-nurses): CE event on nurse-driven innovation and clinical practice transformation
- [Care Without Walls: Nursing Event Series | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/care-without-walls): BAYADA home health nursing series with Alice Benjamin and Stacey Rice

## Nurse Wellness & Appreciation

- [Nurture the Nurse | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/nurture-the-nurse): Hybrid wellness event on nurse self-care with Amy Loughren
- [National Nurses Week 2024 Online Deals & Event | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/national-nurses-week-deals-appreciation): National Nurses Week 2024 virtual celebration with giveaways
- [Celebration Tour at Children's Hospital of Michigan | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/celebration-tour-childrens-hospital-of-michigan-may-2024): National Nurses Week celebration at Children's Hospital of Michigan
- [Ride at Peloton Studios New York | Nurse.com](https://www.nurse.com/events/nyc-cycle-for-nurses): Cycle for Nurses NYC event at Peloton Studios with Hannah Corbin
